title: Flächensauggreifer zum Ansaugen und Handhaben von Gegenständen mit Drucksensoren

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
features.note: The reference describes a base module and a structure, but does not explicitly mention a housing with a hollow grip portion for gripping.

features.item: An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: Due to the negative pressure present in the through-openings 26 and generated by a vacuum generator 28 (indicated by arrows)
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum generator, but does not specify that it is electrically operated or located within a housing as described in the feature.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
features.note: The reference mentions a vacuum generator but does not describe the routing of exhaust air, especially not through a hollow grip portion.

features.item: A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-damping device or a grip portion.

features.item: A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: An elastically compressible structure 22 is provided on the suction side 20, which structure is formed in particular from a foam 24, in particular from a technical sealing foam.
features.note: The reference describes an elastically compressible structure, which acts as a seal, but does not explicitly mention a separate carrier plate or a suction plate as a distinct component with a seal extending around it.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip unit with all these specified components and functionalities.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: A surface suction gripper (10) for sucking up and handling objects (16), comprising a base module (12) in which a vacuum chamber (14) to which negative pressure can be applied is provided
features.note: The reference describes a surface suction gripper with a base module and a suction structure, which implies a combined apparatus, but it does not explicitly define a 'grip unit' and 'suction plate' as distinct components that are combined.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
features.note: The reference does not mention a grip portion or any sound-damping material.

features.item: Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
features.quote: Due to the negative pressure present in the through-openings 26 and generated by a vacuum generator 28 (indicated by arrows)
features.note: The reference mentions a vacuum generator, but does not specify its arrangement within a 'first housing portion' or any specific housing portion.

features.item: Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
features.note: The reference does not mention any sound-reducing device or material in any housing portion.

features.item: Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
features.note: The reference does not describe a grip portion or multiple housing portions with an air outlet on a second portion.

features.item: Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
features.note: The reference does not mention an air collection screw or any specific mechanism for collecting exhaust air upstream of a grip portion.

features.item: Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
features.note: The reference does not describe air baffles or the direction of exhaust air.

features.item: Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
features.note: The reference does not mention a battery coupling point or air baffles directing exhaust air away from it.

features.item: Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a surface suction gripper as a whole, but does not detail a releasable connection between a 'grip unit' and 'suction plate'.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: A surface suction gripper (10) for sucking up and handling objects (16), comprising a base module (12) in which a vacuum chamber (14) to which negative pressure can be applied is provided
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum chamber and suction openings, which are fluidically connected to a structure for gripping, but it does not explicitly define a 'grip unit' with a suction opening connected to a suction chamber delimited by a 'suction plate'.

claims.note: The reference describes a surface suction gripper, but not specifically a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device or for use with a suction plate.

The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not mention exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor a sound-damping device.
The reference describes a surface suction gripper with pressure sensors, but does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
The reference does not describe a grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a base module and a vacuum chamber, but not a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not mention a sound-reducing device in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.

This reference describes a surface suction gripper with a base module and an elastic structure, but it does not describe a grip portion elongated between a first and second housing portion, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
This reference does not describe an air collection device, such as an air collection screw, arranged upstream of a grip portion for collecting exhaust air.
This reference does not describe bent or curved air baffles arranged downstream of a grip portion for guiding exhaust air.

overall.why: The reference describes a surface suction gripper with a vacuum chamber, suction openings, and an elastically compressible structure, which aligns with some aspects of the subject invention's features related to vacuum gripping. It also includes pressure sensors and an evaluation unit for monitoring
